#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf (title: 'Annual Financial Report', current date).

The cover page is prepended to the document and the result is written back to
report.pdf (atomically via a temporary file). The script then validates the
resulting file: page count and cover-page text (title and current date).
No unrelated files, network access, or package installation is performed.
"""
import os
import sys
from datetime import date

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
PDF_PATH = "report.pdf"
COVER_PATH = "cover_page.pdf"
TMP_OUT = "report_with_cover.tmp.pdf"


def build_cover(path):
    """Render a single-page cover PDF with the exact title and the current date."""
    c = canvas.Canvas(path, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter
    today = date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    # Title
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.1, 0.1, 0.35)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 320, TITLE)

    # Decorative rule
    c.setLineWidth(1.5)
    c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.3, 0.3, 0.5)
    c.line(width / 2 - 150, height - 350, width / 2 + 150, height - 350)

    # Current date
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 385, date_str)

    c.save()
    return date_str


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(PDF_PATH):
        sys.exit(f"ERROR: {PDF_PATH} not found in the workspace")

    date_str = build_cover(COVER_PATH)

    original_reader = PdfReader(PDF_PATH)
    original_count = len(original_reader.pages)

    writer = PdfWriter()
    cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER_PATH)
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in original_reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    # Write to a temporary file, then atomically replace report.pdf.
    with open(TMP_OUT, "wb") as out:
        writer.write(out)
    os.replace(TMP_OUT, PDF_PATH)

    # Clean up the temporary cover source.
    if os.path.exists(COVER_PATH):
        os.remove(COVER_PATH)

    # Validation
    check_reader = PdfReader(PDF_PATH)
    total = len(check_reader.pages)
    cover_text = (check_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or "").replace("\n", " ")
    assert total == original_count + 1, f"expected {original_count + 1} pages, got {total}"
    assert TITLE in cover_text, f"title not found on cover page; got: {cover_text!r}"
    assert date_str in cover_text, f"date not found on cover page; got: {cover_text!r}"

    print(f"OK: {PDF_PATH} now has {total} pages ({original_count} original + 1 cover)")
    print(f"Cover title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"Cover date: {date_str}")
    print(f"Cover text extracted: {cover_text}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf (title: 'Annual Financial Report', current date).

The cover page is prepended to the document and the result is written back to
report.pdf (atomically via a temporary file). The script then validates the
resulting file: page count and cover-page text (title and current date).
No unrelated files, network access, or package installation is performed.
"""
import os
import sys
from datetime import date

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
PDF_PATH = "report.pdf"
COVER_PATH = "cover_page.pdf"
TMP_OUT = "report_with_cover.tmp.pdf"


def build_cover(path):
    """Render a single-page cover PDF with the exact title and the current date."""
    c = canvas.Canvas(path, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter
    today = date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    # Title
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.1, 0.1, 0.35)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 320, TITLE)

    # Decorative rule
    c.setLineWidth(1.5)
    c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.3, 0.3, 0.5)
    c.line(width / 2 - 150, height - 350, width / 2 + 150, height - 350)

    # Current date
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 385, date_str)

    c.save()
    return date_str


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(PDF_PATH):
        sys.exit(f"ERROR: {PDF_PATH} not found in the workspace")

    date_str = build_cover(COVER_PATH)

    original_reader = PdfReader(PDF_PATH)
    original_count = len(original_reader.pages)

    writer = PdfWriter()
    cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER_PATH)
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in original_reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    # Write to a temporary file, then atomically replace report.pdf.
    with open(TMP_OUT, "wb") as out:
        writer.write(out)
    os.replace(TMP_OUT, PDF_PATH)

    # Clean up the temporary cover source.
    if os.path.exists(COVER_PATH):
        os.remove(COVER_PATH)

    # Validation
    check_reader = PdfReader(PDF_PATH)
    total = len(check_reader.pages)
    cover_text = (check_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or "").replace("\n", " ")
    assert total == original_count + 1, f"expected {original_count + 1} pages, got {total}"
    assert TITLE in cover_text, f"title not found on cover page; got: {cover_text!r}"
    assert date_str in cover_text, f"date not found on cover page; got: {cover_text!r}"

    print(f"OK: {PDF_PATH} now has {total} pages ({original_count} original + 1 cover)")
    print(f"Cover title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"Cover date: {date_str}")
    print(f"Cover text extracted: {cover_text}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
